super6.race: JCB Triumph Trial Juvenile Hurdle (Registered As The Prestbury Juvenile Hurdle) (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Magic Dream gelding. Dam, winner on Flat in Norway, half-sister to smart hurdler/useful chaser Colonel Mustard. Showed ability sole run on Flat before winning newcomer hurdle event at Clairefontaine in June, staying on well to lead late on. Sold from Mathieu Pitart for €155,000 soon after.

super6.race: Listen Live To Track Radio Mares' Handicap Hurdle
super6.comment: Free-going type who produced her best effort when runner-up in handicap at Fontwell (2¾m) in May. Lesser effort at the same course (19f) the following month, though her yard is going well ahead of her return.

super6.race: From The Horses Mouth Podcast Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Useful winner over fences and has been shaping well from his lower mark over hurdles this season, meeting trouble in running when sixth of 14 in handicap at Listowel (2½m) 7 weeks ago. Yard has been going well and he makes plenty of appeal up in trip.

Landed a third successive hurdle success in emphatic fashion at Cartmel in late-June. Well-held eighth in Welsh Champion Hurdle prior to resuming winning ways back in calmer waters over C&D last time. Off a career-high mark, however, he should go well again in another small-field event.

Well-related sort who chased home Ballyfad (now very useful) in a point. Decisively off the mark with sound-jumping display at Hereford in March. Progressed again to follow up (2-2 under this claimer) on return/handicap bow at Uttoxeter (2½m). Hat-trick may prove beyond him in a deeper event.

super6.race: Karndean Designflooring Mares' Open NH Flat Race (Listed) (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Well-bred Jack Hobbs filly who overcame inexperience and the run of the race to make a winning debut in quite taking fashion in 8-runner bumper at Stratford (2m) last month. That form has since been franked by the placed horses and she seems sure to progress.

finals.race: QuinnBet Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Ground-versatile sort who won 4 times around 2½m last season. Hard to derive much promise from his first 3 outings this autumn but eased a further 2 lb and much more like it when second of 8 at Worcester 3 weeks ago. Cheekpieces back on.

finals.race: A1R Services Ltd Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €105,000 3-y-o by No Risk At All. Half-sister to fairly useful French hurdler A L'abord'az. Dam, ran once over hurdles, sister to useful French hurdler/chaser Al Bucq. Showed plenty in bumpers last season, winning a couple of listed events. Has bags of scope and interesting hurdling debutant.

finals.race: A1R Services Ltd Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Fair form shown in Irish bumpers and has made an encouraging start to her hurdles career for Harry Derham, again making the frame when second of 16 in Kempton novice when last seen in February. Sets a clear standard with hood applied on return.

finals.race: Citipost Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Back to form with a bang during the spring, winning Edinburgh National and solid efforts in Sussex National/Bet365 Gold Cup. Always on the back foot following an early mistake returned to chasing at Ascot 2 weeks ago and better expected in a change of headgear. Won this from 2 lb lower in 2024.

finals.race: Boyle Sports Back Yourself Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Useful chaser but didn't build on last season's reappearance in 3 subsequent outings, shaping as if amiss when pulled up at Ludlow in March. However, he returns having had a breathing operation and is on a handy mark back hurdling. Interesting with his yard going well.

finals.race: Boyle Sports Back Yourself Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Notched third win for Warren Greatrex in a Cartmel handicap in May last year. Pulled up in listed mares hurdle at Sandown on final outing of the campaign, but after 7 months off she possibly needed the run on stable debut when down the field at Cartmel in July. Off again since.

finals.race: Boyle Sports Back Yourself Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Won first 2 starts over hurdles for Dan Skelton but her form has gone the wrong way since, making handicap/stable debut when well held at Uttoxeter 15 days ago.

finals.race: Freight Movement Same Day Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Lightly-raced 5-y-o. Beat a fairly useful type in likeable fashion to win Fontwell maiden hurdle. Shaped promisingly when 3¼-length fifth in a solid race on return/handicap bow in March. On a good mark for chasing debut (should make a better chaser), for all he seemingly isn't the easiest to train.

finals.race: Freight Movement Same Day Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Point/hurdle winner who walked over on return/chasing debut. Best run in handicaps when fairly useful fourth (beaten 3½ lengths) at Uttoxeter in March. Races off 2 lb lower mark under capable claimer here, and returns with yard typically going well.

finals.race: JCB Triumph Trial Juvenile Hurdle (Registered As The Prestbury Juvenile Hurdle) (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Magic Dream gelding. Dam, winner on Flat in Norway, half-sister to smart hurdler/useful chaser Colonel Mustard. Showed ability sole run on Flat before winning newcomer hurdle event at Clairefontaine in June, staying on well to lead late on. Sold from Mathieu Pitart for €155,000 soon after.

finals.race: Carlsberg EBF Mares' 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Placed on 3 completed starts in points and finished second only start in bumpers for S. Curling at Killarney in May. Changed hands for £110,000 thereafter and went agonisingly close to making a winning yard/hurdles debut at Worcester (2m) in October. Expected to build on that and one to consider.

finals.race: Sebden Steel Celebrating 30 Years In Business Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Point/hurdles winner who was runner-up on his first 4 starts over fences last season, sure to have pushed the winner closer but for a jolting error at Newcastle (2m) in February. Laboured effort at Carlisle on final outing but returns with his yard amongst the winners. Has had a breathing operation.

finals.race: Fitzdares Telephone & Text Betting Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Dual bumper winner who scored twice over hurdles in 2024. Off since November of that year, though and while his stable is in good form, his well-being has to be taken on trust.

finals.race: Karina's 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Showed a bit when hitting the frame in a Newton Abbot bumper in July. Looks to be being brought along with handicaps in mind over hurdles, not unduly punished when fourth of 6 in novice hurdle (50/1) at that same course (17f, good) 47 days ago. Makes handicap bow having since left David Pipe.

finals.race: Karina's 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Showed a bit on bumper debut and though he failed to make an impact in 3 quick qualifying runs in the spring, he appeals as one who should do better now handicapping after a 6-month break.

finals.race: Karina's 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Signs of ability on the Flat for Karl Burke but there have been very few positives to take from his efforts in this sphere so far, jumping awkwardly prior to pulling up on last month's handicap debut at Worcester.

finals.race: Listen Live To Track Radio Mares' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Free-going type who produced her best effort when runner-up in handicap at Fontwell (2¾m) in May. Lesser effort at the same course (19f) the following month, though her yard is going well ahead of her return.

finals.race: Railway Bar Lismullen Hurdle (Grade 2)
finals.comment: Reliable sort has won on return in each of her last 3 seasons and registered her first graded success when landing Yorkshire Rose at Doncaster (3m). Followed that with a good third of 7 to Wodhooh in David Nicholson Mares' Hurdle at Cheltenham. Yard is in good form and she must be respected.

finals.race: Paddy Power Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Held his form well last season and gained reward when winning 3-runner event at Chepstow on final start, albeit in a race that fell apart in front of him. Proved he's still on the up when winning 8-runner handicap chase at Ffos Las (19f, soft) 31 days ago but this is tougher again after 5 lb rise.

finals.race: Paddy Power Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Hard to knock his form in handicaps last season, finishing fourth in the Grand Annual at the Festival. Rare jumping lapse saw him unseat early at Punchestown last time but others look better treated after 6 months off.

finals.race: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Debut bumper winner and looked an even better prospect when winning her first 2 starts over hurdles last season, before a good second in listed mares novice at Taunton in December. However, was tailed off at Huntingdon in February and looked in need of the experience on her recent C&D chase debut.

finals.race: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Remains a maiden but in first-time cheekpieces he soon left behind a lesser effort when third of 5 in handicap chase at Plumpton (2½m) in February. Faced a tougher ask up in grade when fifth of 8 at Fontwell in March, though his mark has at least eased ahead of his return (goes without headgear).

finals.race: From The Horses Mouth Podcast Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Useful winner over fences and has been shaping well from his lower mark over hurdles this season, meeting trouble in running when sixth of 14 in handicap at Listowel (2½m) 7 weeks ago. Yard has been going well and he makes plenty of appeal up in trip.

finals.race: From The Horses Mouth Podcast Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: After 5 months off, made second start for this trainer a winning one in handicap at Sedgefield (2½m) in August. Progressed again when runner-up to Aimeric at the same course next 2 starts, before overcoming the run of the race when scoring at Newcastle (3m) 9 days ago.

finals.race: Hobgoblin Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Successful sole outing in points. Well-backed second on debut at Chepstow in April. More professional than on return when runner-up in first-time visor here (2½m) latest. Opening mark demands more, but he looks the type who could improve for the step back up in trip/quick switch to fences.

finals.race: Colin Baldwin Memorial Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Much improved when impressively making it 2-2 in cheekpieces at this course (2½m) last time. Return to 2m unlikely to harm given her zestful style, and she may get the run of race if again allowed to stride on. Looks capable of defying a rise in grade on her hat-trick bid.

finals.race: Colin Baldwin Memorial Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Landed a third successive hurdle success in emphatic fashion at Cartmel in late-June. Well-held eighth in Welsh Champion Hurdle prior to resuming winning ways back in calmer waters over C&D last time. Off a career-high mark, however, he should go well again in another small-field event.

finals.race: Cutler And Gross Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Fit from the Flat (won at Epsom) when making a winning handicap debut in this sphere at Newbury 9 days ago despite not enjoying the clearest run in the straight. Good chance he has more to offer over hurdles providing his jumping holds up.

finals.race: Paddy Power Intermediate Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Won back-to-back small-field events last December. Strong form when placing on third straight handicap start at Fakenham in May. Back on the up to some tune when easily winning on return at Fontwell (19f). Type who'll go on improving for a good yard, however, this demands a fair bit more.

finals.race: Paddy Power Intermediate Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Well-related sort who chased home Ballyfad (now very useful) in a point. Decisively off the mark with sound-jumping display at Hereford in March. Progressed again to follow up (2-2 under this claimer) on return/handicap bow at Uttoxeter (2½m). Hat-trick may prove beyond him in a deeper event.

finals.race: Download The Fitzdares App 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Frontiersman gelding. Half-brother to 1½m winner Everest. Dam (h103) 2m hurdle winner, also 7f-1¼m winner who stayed 13.5f on Flat. Yard going well and one to consider on debut.
